transformationPolicy.normalized: Replace local paths and observed hostnames; serverInfo.host becomes local-experiment-host; omit fsUsedSize/fsTotalSize host inventory. Preserve source measurements, owned process resource observations and exact operation denominators.
transformationPolicy.exact: Frozen sources and protocol copied byte for byte after hash verification and privacy scan. Compact session snapshots were produced by the frozen runner after full-value oracle checks; exporter does not replace cold bodies or claim compact projections are full payloads.
transformationPolicy.summaries: Derived reports omit database diagnostics and runtime download URL subtrees. All normalized diagnostics and original public download provenance remain in the archive.
transformationPolicy.exclusions: No worker logs, database state, binaries, credentials, general host inventory or arbitrary runtime files. Uncounted smoke runs contribute manifest/report/interruption metadata only. Explicitly excluded interrupted measured runs retain all curated raw operations, snapshots, resources, host observations, diagnosis/interruption and independently hash-verified original sources; none are pooled with the amended run.
transformationPolicy.archive: Sorted regular files; mode 0644, epoch timestamps, owner zero; COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 excludes AppleDouble; exact member set verified; gzip mtime zero. SHA binds actual bytes, not cross-platform reproducibility.
